8.3.14 EthTrcv_SetPhyTxMode
[SWS_EthTrcv_91007] Definition of API function EthTrcv_SetPhyTxMode ⌈
Service Name
EthTrcv_SetPhyTxMode
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthTrcv_SetPhyTxMode (
uint8 TrcvIdx,
EthTrcv_PhyTxModeType Mode
)
Service ID [hex]
0x13
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different TrcvIdx. Non reentrant for the same TrcvIdx.
TrcvIdx
Index of the transceiver within the context of the Ethernet
Transceiver Driver
Parameters (in)
Mode
Transmission mode to be activated
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The request has been accepted
E_NOT_OK: The request has not been accepted
Description
Activates a given transmission mode.
Available via
EthTrcv.h
⌋(SRS_Eth_00117)
[SWS_EthTrcv_00168] ⌈If the internal cable diagnostic state is ETHTRCV_CABLE-
DIAG_PENDING, the EthTrcv_SetPhyTxMode shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋()
[SWS_EthTrcv_00148] ⌈If development error detection is enabled: the function Eth
Trcv_SetPhyTxMode shall check the parameter Mode for being supported by the hard-
ware. If the check fails, the function shall raise the development error ETHTRCV_E_
NOT_SUPPORTED.⌋()
